caption: This drawing depicts two objects on a plain, off-white background. The top object is a flat, metal piece shaped like the sole of an iron, with a rounded triangular outline and a circular opening in the center. It features an ornate, intertwined monogram and the text "ST. LOUIS, MO." engraved along the right side. The object is primarily brown with shading to indicate metallic texture and depth. The lower object is a horizontal, rectangular bar supported by two short legs, drawn in a muted brown tone with detailed shading to suggest a solid or metallic surface. Both objects are centrally aligned on the page, with the artist's signature, "William R. Ludwig," written in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Trivet
